text:
The 1986 FIFA World Cup mere na Mexico site na 31 May ruo 29 June, mba ahụ bụ nke mbụ na-eme emume ahụ ugboro abụọ mgbe ha mere nke 1970. Mexico batara mgbe Colombia, ndị e bu ụzọ họpụta, kwụsịrị. Ndị otu iri abụọ na anọ sonyere, e kewara ha n’ime otu isii nke anọ; ndị abụọ kacha elu n’otu ọ bụla, tinyere ndị anọ kacha mma n’ọkwa nke atọ, gara n’ọkwa nke 16. Nke a bụ World Cup mbụ e jiri usoro round of 16, wee soro quarter-finals, semi-finals, egwuregwu nke atọ na nke ikpeazụ. Egwuregwu ndị ahụ mere n’ebe dị elu na okpomọkụ, ụfọdụ malitere n’ehihie iji kwado ndị na-ekiri TV Europe. Canada, Denmark na Iraq mere mpụta mbụ ha. Ndị mmadụ 2,394,031 bịara n’ime egwuregwu 52, ihe dị ka 46,039 kwa egwuregwu.

Egwuregwu ahụ bụ nke Diego Maradona, onye duuru Argentina nweta aha nke a na-ewere dị ka mgbasa ozi World Cup kacha mma nke onye ọ bụla. N’ọkara ikpeazụ megide England ọ gbara goolu abụọ, ‘Hand of God’ nke a kụrụ n’aka na-enweghị onye ọrụ ahụ hụrụ, na nkeji ole na ole mgbe e mesịrị ‘Goal of the Century’, na-agbafe ọtụtụ ndị England site na ọkara ya. N’ime asọmpi ahụ Maradona gbara goolu ise ma nye aka ise, aka na goolu 10 n’ime 14 nke Argentina, ma nweta Golden Ball dị ka onye ọkpụkpọ kacha mma.

France, nke Michel Platini duziri, meriri ndị Italy na-achị 2–0 na round of 16, wee merie Brazil na penalties (4–3) mgbe 1–1 gasịrị, tupu ha emerie West Germany na semi-final ma nweta ọnọdụ nke atọ. Belgium ruru semi-finals maka oge mbụ, mechaa nke anọ.

Final na Estadio Azteca na Mexico City na 29 June hụrụ Argentina na West Germany. José Luis Brown mepere goolu na nkeji 23 na Jorge Valdano tinye nke abụọ na nkeji 56. West Germany weghaara site na Karl-Heinz Rummenigge (74′) na Rudi Völler (81′), mana Jorge Burruchaga gbara onye mmeri na nkeji 84 site na pasị Maradona. Argentina meriri 3–2 n’oge nkịtị iji nweta aha ụwa nke abụọ, mgbe 1978 gasịrị. Gary Lineker nke England bụ onye gbara goolu kacha elu na asọmpi ahụ na goolu isii.
